title: LSTM-Style Looped Transformers with Shared KV Caches
abstract: arXiv:2610.33360v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recurrent transformers reuse weights to perform deep computation with fewer parameters. We study an LSTM-style transformer that also shares one key--value cache across its recurrent core. At width 1024, it uses 40.4% fewer parameters than an untied control at nearly matched forward FLOPs, and reduces persistent cache sets from fifteen to four. Parallel training supplies cache entries from a standard-attention pass, whereas continuation reads entries produced recursively using shared attention. We address this mismatch by aligning the two training passes' cache entries with a consistency loss during the final 10% of a fixed training-token budget. Across three model widths on FineWeb, this removes 81--89% of the continuation-loss penalty relative to full-cache evaluation. The improvement replicates on disjoint documents for two training seeds. translated_title: 具有共享KV缓存的LSTM风格循环Transformer
translated_abstract: 循环Transformer通过重用权重以更少的参数执行深度计算。我们研究了一种LSTM风格的Transformer，它还在其循环核心中共享一个键值（KV）缓存。在宽度为1024时，在前向FLOPs几乎匹配的情况下，它比未绑定权重的对照组少使用40.4%的参数，并将持久缓存集从十五个减少到四个。并行训练从标准注意力传递中提供缓存条目，而续写则读取通过共享注意力递归生成的条目。我们通过在固定训练token预算的最后10%期间，使用一致性损失来对齐两次训练过程的缓存条目，从而解决这一不匹配问题。在FineWeb上的三个模型宽度中，该方法消除了相对于完整缓存评估的81%至89%的续写损失惩罚。该改进在两个训练种子下的不相交文档上均得到了复现。在四个宽度和1.05至4.19B训练token的范围内，权重绑定的损失成本在……时最小
tldr: 该论文提出了一种LSTM风格的循环Transformer，通过在循环核心中共享单一KV缓存，并在训练末期使用一致性损失对齐并行与递归两种方式的缓存条目，在参数减少40.4%的同时消除了81–89%的权重共享带来的续写损失惩罚。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an LSTM-style looped transformer that shares a single KV cache across its recurrent core and aligns parallel and recursive cache entries with a consistency loss during late training, reducing parameters by 40.4% while removing 81–89% of the continuation-loss penalty from weight sharing.
